authors: Pontius, R.G. Jr., Krithivasan, R., Sauls, L., Yan, Y. & Zhang, Y.
title: Methods to summarize change among land categories across time intervals
relevance: Proposes three summary metrics for multi-date change that the CEOS protocol (ID 187) recommends estimating from the REFERENCE SAMPLE and comparing against the same metrics computed from the map: the number of change incidents, the number of distinct classes a location takes across all time points, and the flow matrices between dates. The second is directly a FLICKER measure - and computing it on both the sample and the model gives us the first principled way to test whether our observed year-to-year instability is real change or model noise, which nothing in the pipeline currently distinguishes. Cheap, uses the P3 sample we are already planning, and answers a question STATE has carried open since the flicker work.
